observationEncoding.rule: Unknown is preserved and must never be coerced to absent.

observationWindow: Information documented before disposition in the prespecified index encounter.

observations.label: Febre
observations.presentDefinition: Highest measured temperature is at least 38.0 degC during the index encounter.
observations.absentDefinition: A measured temperature below 38.0 degC and an explicit source statement that fever is absent.
observations.unknownDefinition: Temperature is not measured, unit is unresolved, or fever status is not explicit.

observations.label: Tosse
observations.presentDefinition: Cough is explicitly documented as present in the index encounter.
observations.absentDefinition: Cough is explicitly denied or documented as absent.

observations.label: Coriza
observations.presentDefinition: Coryza, rhinorrhea, or nasal obstruction is explicitly documented as present.
observations.absentDefinition: Coryza, rhinorrhea, and nasal obstruction are explicitly documented as absent.
observations.unknownDefinition: Nasal symptom status is not documented.

observations.label: Dor de garganta
observations.presentDefinition: Sore throat or odynophagia is explicitly documented as present.
observations.absentDefinition: Sore throat and odynophagia are explicitly documented as absent.
observations.unknownDefinition: Throat symptom status is not documented or cannot be assessed.

observations.label: Dispneia
observations.presentDefinition: Respiratory difficulty, dyspnea, increased work of breathing, retractions, or nasal flaring is explicitly documented as present.
observations.absentDefinition: Respiratory difficulty and increased work of breathing are explicitly documented as absent.

observations.label: Sibilância
observations.presentDefinition: Wheeze is documented by examination or a clinician records current wheezing.
observations.absentDefinition: Wheeze is explicitly documented as absent on examination.
observations.unknownDefinition: Auscultation or wheeze status is not documented.

observations.label: Estridor
observations.presentDefinition: Stridor at rest is explicitly documented.
observations.absentDefinition: Stridor at rest is explicitly documented as absent.
observations.unknownDefinition: Resting stridor status is not documented.

observations.label: Taquipneia
observations.presentDefinition: A clinician documents tachypnea for age or a respiratory-rate derivation approved in the locked site mapping evaluates true.
observations.absentDefinition: A clinician explicitly documents no tachypnea or the approved age-specific derivation evaluates false from a valid resting measurement.
observations.unknownDefinition: Respiratory rate, age band, measurement state, or mapping rule is missing or unresolved.

observations.label: Hipoxemia
observations.presentDefinition: Room-air SpO2 is below 92% or hypoxemia is explicitly documented before oxygen treatment.
observations.absentDefinition: Valid room-air SpO2 is at least 92% and hypoxemia is explicitly absent.
observations.unknownDefinition: SpO2 is missing, invalid, measured only after oxygen, or oxygen status is unresolved.

observations.label: Tosse paroxística
observations.presentDefinition: Paroxysmal cough, inspiratory whoop, or post-tussive vomiting is explicitly documented.
observations.absentDefinition: These features are explicitly documented as absent.

observations.label: Menor de 2 anos
observations.unknownDefinition: ageDays is missing or outside the permitted range.

observations.label: Duração maior que 10 dias
observations.presentDefinition: The current respiratory symptom episode has lasted more than 10 completed days at the index encounter.
observations.absentDefinition: Duration is explicitly 10 completed days or less.
observations.unknownDefinition: Episode start or duration is not documented precisely enough to classify.

referenceConditions.label: IVAS
referenceConditions.referenceRule: Independent double chart review using the frozen adjudication manual; billing code alone is insufficient.

referenceConditions.label: Pneumonia pediátrica
referenceConditions.referenceRule: Independent double chart review using the frozen adjudication manual; radiography is supportive but not mandatory unless required by the site protocol.

referenceConditions.label: Bronquiolite
referenceConditions.referenceRule: Independent double chart review using the frozen adjudication manual.

referenceConditions.label: Asma ou sibilância viral
referenceConditions.referenceRule: Independent double chart review using the frozen adjudication manual.

referenceConditions.label: Crupe
referenceConditions.referenceRule: Independent double chart review using the frozen adjudication manual.

referenceConditions.label: Coqueluche
referenceConditions.referenceRule: Independent double chart review using the frozen adjudication manual; laboratory evidence is recorded when available.

referenceConditions.label: Síndrome gripal viral
referenceConditions.referenceRule: Independent double chart review using the frozen adjudication manual; virologic evidence is recorded when available.

referenceConditions.label: Faringite aguda
referenceConditions.referenceRule: Independent double chart review using the frozen adjudication manual.

referenceConditions.label: Outra condição ou informação insuficiente
referenceConditions.referenceRule: Used when the presentation is outside the eight named classes or remains unresolved after double adjudication; the rationale is retained at the source site only.
